name: Image AI Labels
author: Meindl Webdesign

sections.description:
Image AI Labels marks AI-generated images on your WordPress website with a clearly visible label (“AI-generated” / “KI-generiert”) – helping you prepare for upcoming legal labeling requirements for AI content.

Beta version: This plugin is currently in beta. If you notice a bug or have feedback, please contact us directly at kontakt@ai-label24.de rather than only leaving a review.

The free version reliably labels all standard images in your posts and pages. Does your theme use complex CSS background images or a page builder like Elementor? Then check out our Pro plugin below.

How it works:

  1. Open the media library (list view) – you will find a new “AI Label” column there.
  2. Check the box for every AI-generated image.
  3. The label automatically appears wherever the image is displayed on your website.

Features:

  • Checkbox marking in the media library (list & detail view)
  • Custom label text in German and English (automatically selected based on the site language)
  • Adjustable font size
  • Adjustable label size/padding
  • Adjustable background opacity
  • Live preview in the settings screen
  • Settings screen available in German and English (switchable)
  • Clean, readable default style: black background, white text, bottom-right corner of the image
  • Works with WooCommerce product images (shop archive, product page, images loaded via AJAX)

This plugin does not connect to any external service and does not transmit any data.

Additional features in our separate, standalone Pro plugin (not part of this plugin’s code):

  • Label background images too – e.g. Elementor section/container/column/widget backgrounds (CSS background instead of an <img> tag)
  • Free positioning of the label (9 positions + custom edge margin)
  • Custom font color & background color
  • Custom font family, optionally auto-loaded from Google Fonts
  • Mark WooCommerce product images directly in the product editor (featured image + gallery)
  • Choose a custom preview image from the media library for the live preview on the settings screen

More information: ai-label24.de
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via “Plugins -> Add New”.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to “Settings -> Image AI Labels” to configure the label text, font size and opacity.
  4. In the media library, check the box for every image that should be marked as AI-generated.
sections.faq:
Are all images labeled automatically?

No. You decide per image, via a checkbox in the media library, which images are marked as AI-generated.

Where exactly is the label displayed?

Wherever a marked image is output through the media library in posts/pages. The position is calculated dynamically based on the actual rendered image size, so it stays correctly placed even with responsive layouts.

Is any data sent to third parties?

No. This plugin does not connect to any external server and does not transmit any data.
